text: Crossley, a mysterious travelling man, [invades the lives|trigger|an outsider reaches in] of Rachel and Anthony Fielding, a young couple living in secluded Devon. Anthony is a composer who experiments with sound effects and electronic sources in [his studio|images|sounds, smells and silence]. The couple offer Crossley hospitality, but his intentions grow gradually more sinister. He claims an Aboriginal shaman taught him [a terror shout|threat|witchcraft and cursed things] that can kill anyone who hears it unprotected.
